name: WhisperGate
blurb: Draft exercise based on the documented incident “WhisperGate” (CTID Attack Flow corpus). A Russian state-sponsored malware campaign targeting Ukraine.

injects.title: Valid Accounts
injects.text: Attackers gained initial access through stolen credentials and likely had access to the victim's network for months. The malware is written to the C: drive in various directories and executes via Impacket.

injects.title: Bootkit
injects.text: Executable wipes the MBR and replaces it with the ransom note. The malware executes a base64-encoded PowerShell command twice to make the machine sleep for 20 seconds.

decision.prompt: Responders see this activity (Bootkit). What do they do?

choices.label: Privileged Account Management focuses on implementing policies, controls, and tools to securely manage privileged accounts (e.g., SYSTEM, root, or administrative accounts).
choices.lesson: ATT&CK: Privileged Account Management focuses on implementing policies, controls, and tools to securely manage privileged accounts (e.g., SYSTEM, root, or administrative accounts). This mitigation applies to 2 behaviour(s) in this stage.

choices.label: Auditing is the process of recording activity and systematically reviewing and analyzing the activity and system configurations.
choices.lesson: A partial fix: Auditing is the process of recording activity and systematically reviewing and analyzing the activity and system configurations. It helps, but misses the primary control for this behaviour.

choices.label: Treat it as noise and continue business as usual.
choices.lesson: Early-stage activity is usually the last cheap moment to intervene; waiting converts a contained event into an incident.

injects.title: Steganography
injects.text: JPG file is loaded as a .NET assembly file; when restored, it is a Win32 DLL. The script modifies Windows Defender settings to exclude the C: from being scanned.

decision.prompt: Responders see this activity (Steganography). What do they do?

injects.title: Deobfuscate/Decode Files or Information
injects.text: A resource from the DLL is loaded into memory and decoded by a XOR operation. Waqybg resource is loaded into memory and restores it as the wiper payload. The DLL then injects the payload into legitimate Windows utility…

injects.title: InstallUtil
injects.text: The malware executes Waqybg through the legitimate program InstallUtil. The wiper looks for fixed logical drives in the system.

injects.title: System Network Connections Discovery
injects.text: The wiper looks for remote logical drives in the system. For each enumeration, the malware wipes the files in the logical drive with specific file extensions, while ignoring files in the %HOMEDRIVE%/Windows.

injects.title: File Deletion
injects.text: WhisperGate deletes InstallerUtil.exe" from the %TEMP% directory. WhisperGate attempts to stop all running processes (including itself) by calling ExitWindowsEx API.

objectives.text: Make the best call on at least half of the decisions
